verdict.line: You lose if you let Tahm stack three tongues and stand in his engage range after level 6; you win if you poke with Q and E and never let him close the gap for free.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a disengage check: Tahm Kench has no way to force a fight on you if you respect Hallowed Mist and his Q (Tongue Lash) cooldown, since he has zero gap-close outside of his 7-5s tongue range and his all-in requires three stacks of An Acquired Taste to land a stun. The data backs this up at 59.1% over 137 games, well above Gwen's 50.3% baseline into the role.

tell.watch: Tahm's Q cooldown and stack count

theirWindow.when: You're in Tongue Lash range with 3 stacks up
theirWindow.what: If he lands Q (Tongue Lash) while you're already carrying 2 stacks of An Acquired Taste, the third stack stuns you and he can walk in freely; back off the moment you see 2 stacks rather than waiting for the stun to confirm it.

yourWindow.when: His Q (Tongue Lash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Tahm has no other poke or gap-close, so every 5-7s window after he whiffs or lands Q is a window to walk up and snip with Q (Snip Snip!) for free trades, since he can't punish you without that tongue.

powerCurve.note: Trade Q pokes, respect his tongue range
W (Hallowed Mist) denies his only engage tool
His R (Devour) threatens all-in near turret
E refund loop outscales his flat stats
Burst items punish his low mobility

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The sustain from two potions lets you tank chip damage from his Q while you wait out cooldowns to poke back, and the extra mana keeps your Q cycling every 6.5s at level 1 without going dry.

boots.why: Tahm's kit has no hard CC outside the 3-stack stun, so the magic penetration matters more than tenacity for racing down his stacked passive HP damage reduction.

core.why: Builds your early tempo so you can threaten trades the instant his Q is down.
Tahm stacks a lot of health off his passive, and this punishes high-HP targets directly.
The omnivamp sustains you through the poke war while his Q keeps chipping your HP bar.

situational.when: the game goes long and you're ahead on tempo
he lands his Devour stun combo and you need to survive the follow-up
you want faster Q resets for the extended poke war

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are the whole matchup here, since he has no dash and you can kite with E (Skip 'n Slash) while stacking Conqueror for the sustained damage and heal.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes his Thick Skin shield-heal loop directly and secures kills once you've worn his stacks down, which is why it sits at 68.1% pick rate and the higher win rate of the two options.

playing.title: Poke only when his Q is down
playing.detail: Tahm has no way to close distance outside Tongue Lash's 900 range, so walk up and land Q (Snip Snip!) the moment his tongue is on cooldown and back off before it's back up.

playing.title: Track his Acquired Taste stacks
playing.detail: He needs 3 stacks to stun you off Q; disengage the instant you're sitting on 2 stacks rather than risking the third landing.

playing.title: Use W to deny his engage
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist means only enemies who enter the mist can target you, so drop it the moment he closes in and he has nothing left to punish you with.

playing.title: Respect level 6 Devour threat
playing.detail: His R has no cooldown listed but requires him to be in melee range already; don't overextend near his turret or jungle entrances once he hits 6.

playing.title: Abuse E's attack speed window
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash grants attack speed and range on-hit after the dash, and lands a cooldown refund if you connect, so chain it immediately after a Q poke to extend the trade.

playing.title: Save R for a two-champion read
playing.detail: Needlework can be cast up to two more times for more damage, so hold it for moments he commits past his Thick Skin shield rather than poking it away early.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and the 59.1% over 137 games figure are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning about tongue range, stack timing, and mist usage is tactical analysis, not measured data.
